high_level_description: The image shows a bottle of Rémy Martin Fine Champagne Cognac VSOP. The bottle is dark brown with a sleek design, featuring a black label that prominently displays the Rémy Martin logo—a gold horse within a black oval. Below the logo, the text "Rémy Martin" is written in gold, followed by "Fine Champagne Cognac" in smaller white letters. The VSOP (Very Special Old Pale) designation is highlighted on a red rectangular label below the main text. The bottle has a green foil seal around the neck, which is partially visible. The cap is black and appears to be made of plastic or metal
